title: THE NIGHT OPERATOR SEEMS… FAMILIAR.
body: A yellow note on the memo board, between a reminder about the fourth-floor printer and a lunch rotation nobody has filled in. Day-crew handwriting, unhurried, lowercase: the night operator seems... familiar. i can't place him. — D. The note is dated today. You are the night operator. There is no photograph of you on any wall. The day crew left this at 16:00, while you were somewhere the log says you were not.

outcome.text: The second reading is worse. The note is dated today, in a hand that predates the building's coffee — and under the first line, fainter, almost erased: do not ask him how long he has worked here. Someone in the day crew already knows the answer and does not want it said out loud.
You leave it. It is about you, and you are not ready to be a topic. The yellow square glows in the dark of the office like a small, patient sun. Tomorrow it will say something else.
